Markets.title: Spain mandates new 20-year green bond syndication, seeks to raise €4 billion
Markets.summary: Spain has mandated a syndicate of major banks to issue a new 20-year green government bond. The offering aims to raise approximately four billion euros.

Markets.title: Indian bonds end flat as traders gauge RBI liquidity approach
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds ended the session flat due to the Reserve Bank of India's temporary liquidity management strategies and variable rate reverse repos. Additionally, rising oil prices prevented bond prices from making any gains.

Markets.title: Party's over for crypto scammers who went on a spending spree after a $240 million bitcoin theft
Markets.summary: The FBI arrested Malone Lam and 17 others for a social engineering heist that stole over $240 million in bitcoin. The suspects used the stolen funds to finance luxury mansions and a month-long spending spree.

Markets.title: Vodafone Idea among 4 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rallied up to 22% in a month
Markets.summary: Despite a drop in the Sensex, four BSE 200 stocks—Vodafone Idea, Lenskart Solutions, Solar Industries India, and Divi's Laboratories—reached 52-week highs on Monday. Vodafone Idea and Lenskart led the group, each surging up to 22% over the past month.

Markets.title: Sebi eases compliance norms for FPIs investing only in government securities
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi has removed the requirement for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) investing solely in government securities to provide investor group details. This change follows the Reserve Bank of India's decision to lift concentration limits for these specific FPIs.

Markets.title: When Nithin Kamath met Karthik Rangappa: The journey from international investor account sales pitch to heading Varsity
Markets.summary: Zerodha co-founder Nithin Kamath credited Karthik Rangappa as central to building Zerodha Varsity, the brokerage's free financial education platform. Kamath emphasized that Varsity's core purpose is financial education rather than customer acquisition.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's far-right AfD says 'democracy demands' parties work with them after state election win
Geo-Political.summary: Following a state election win where it fell just three seats short of a majority, Germany's far-right AfD party is attempting to form a government. The party stated that democracy requires other political parties to work with them.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanese village kill 12
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli airstrikes in a southern Lebanese village killed 12 people. Lebanon stated that this escalation threatens the US-brokered ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah.

Geo-Political.title: New videos of man in 9/11 lawsuit reveal extremist links
Geo-Political.summary: Newly surfaced videos and FBI evidence contradict Omar al-Bayoumi's 25-year-old denials of involvement. The uncovered materials reveal significant extremist links relevant to the ongoing 9/11 lawsuit.

Geo-Political.title: Probe begins into why cargo plane overran Miami runway
Geo-Political.summary: An investigation has started regarding an Amazon cargo plane that overshot the runway after landing at Miami International Airport. The incident resulted in five fatalities and five injuries.

Geo-Political.title: Kyiv air raid alerts at record high as Russia launches round-the-clock strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Kyiv has reached a record high in air raid alerts as Russia conducts continuous, round-the-clock airstrikes. These attacks have severely disrupted local schools, businesses, and public transport.

Geo-Political.title: Nepal observes national day of mourning for victims of flash flood disaster
Geo-Political.summary: Nepal observed a national day of mourning for the victims of a recent flash flood disaster. Flags flew at half-mast on the 13th day, marking the conclusion of the Hindu mourning period.

Data & Insights.summary: The Confederation of Indian Industry's Business Confidence Index rose to 66 in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. This rebound was driven by stronger domestic demand, higher capacity utilization, and an improved outlook for hiring and investment.

Data & Insights.title: Tech glitch or weak demand? Conflicting claims emerge as RBI launches another liquidity withdrawal op; check details
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is launching a ₹5 trillion variable rate reverse repo auction on September 7. This follows a previous longer-tenor auction that received only ₹2.59 trillion in offers, sparking debate over whether the outcome was due to a tech glitch or weak demand.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting postponed to 7 October from 12 September
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council meeting has been postponed from 12 September to 7 October. Ahead of this meeting, preparatory sessions for government officers are scheduled for 5 and 6 October.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why the era of cheap money is ending
Data & Insights.summary: Moody’s Ratings reports that a shift toward higher interest rates is driving differentiated repricing across financial assets. This transition marks the end of the era of cheap money, according to a recent macroeconomic analysis.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting rescheduled: BRICS Summit clash pushes 57th meet to October 7
Data & Insights.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting has been rescheduled from September 12 to October 7 due to a scheduling conflict with the BRICS Summit. The upcoming meeting is expected to address pending tax issues, including input tax credit, corporate guarantees, and rate rationalisation.

Data & Insights.title: Smaller economy, PPI inclusion: Why India’s GDP is facing fresh scrutiny
Data & Insights.summary: India's updated GDP methodology resolves previous statistical problems while introducing downward nominal revisions. However, the sudden addition of the Producer Price Index has sparked new concerns regarding data credibility.

India.title: Collapsed Delhi Hostel's Rent Agreement Left Owner With Zero Responsibility
India.summary: Students paid upfront rent and security deposits for a Delhi hostel under strict, non-negotiable terms. The hostel's rent agreement absolved the owner of any responsibility for the students' safety.

India.title: Inside Mayawati's Family Tussle: Changing Roles And An Upcoming Election
India.summary: Two developments rocked Mayawati's party on Sunday, indicating ongoing internal trouble. These events highlight a family power struggle and changing roles ahead of an upcoming election.

India.title: Adani Power's ESG Rating Improves To 66 In NSE Sustainability Assessment
India.summary: Adani Power's ESG rating improved to 66 in the NSE sustainability assessment. The company credited this upgrade to its focus on operational efficiency and sustainability initiatives.

India.title: Video: Lamborghini, BMWs Caught Racing Inside Mumbai Tunnel, Police Act
India.summary: Mumbai police have identified several luxury vehicles, including a Lamborghini and BMWs, that were caught racing inside a city tunnel. Although no arrests have been made yet, authorities are expected to take the vehicles into custody shortly.

India.title: From Dog Walk Row To Delhi Tragedy: IAS Officer Sanjeev Khirwar In Spotlight
India.summary: An IAS officer named Sanjeev Khirwar is facing intense scrutiny following a tragic incident in Delhi. Meanwhile, a boys' paying guest accommodation in Satya Niketan collapsed during repair work on Sunday.

India.title: FT Rankings 2026: IIM Bangalore Tops India In Masters In Management, Ranks 21st Globally
India.summary: IIM Bangalore ranked 21st globally in the Financial Times Masters in Management 2026 rankings, placing it first among Indian institutions. This is an improvement from its 28th position in 2025 and 41st in 2024.
